text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *pant*... ha... ah. Ah...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't... reach them... 2,400 
meters...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

After finishing the race, Nishino Flower 
lay down to rest for a while, perhaps from 
sheer exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I'm truly, deeply sorry. I couldn't... 
win...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... if only I had pushed a little 
harder. If only I could've used the time I 
rested for proper training...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I'd just thought more about my body, 
then today...
choice_data_list:
There's nothing wrong with giving it your 
all.

text_block_list.text:
It might be true that we weren't at our 
absolute best. However, the real cause of 
this defeat lies elsewhere.

"Normally, the next race would be the 
Shuka Sho—a medium-distance race just like 
today's. However, looking at today's 
results..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your race from here. It was 
like a sudden gale, such magnificent 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. When that blooms... you will 
likely find yourself facing each other 
directly.

There are other races where Nishino Flower 
can make the most of her strengths. In 
that case...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Let's take the Shuka Sho off our goals.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Is it because... I betrayed your 
expectations, Trainer...?"

"Today's race was also the result of her 
doing her best in her own way. Depending 
on her conditioning, running in the Shuka 
Sho is an option. But..."
choice_data_list:
There must be a stage where you can shine 
even brighter

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Shine...? Does that mean...
choice_data_list:
Why don't we try taking on sprint races 
from now on?

Why don't we try taking on sprint races 
from now on?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I'm a little relieved. Deep down, I 
knew all along too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks is an amazing race, and I really 
wanted to do my best, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it was hard for me... There were 
painful times, too...!”
choice_data_list: Thank you for working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If it's a sprint, I'm sure I can give it 
even more of my all. Let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"So... what should our goal be? Given the 
timing, a summer graded race first, 
perhaps?"

Just as she thinks, easing in during the 
bustling summer sprint races is one 
option. But with her potential— she can 
aim for something far bigger!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait, that's a GⅠ, isn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Switching paths, right off the bat? And 
what's more, the Senior-class older girls 
are running too...

For Nishino Flower, this will be her first 
target race running alongside her senior 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm... just a 'kid,' after all, 
aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Going against older girls... ...Will I 
even stand a chance?

Nishino Flower had always been 
self-conscious about still being young 
compared to the other girls. It was only 
natural that facing senior runners put 
pressure on her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, the way I am right now...
choice_data_list: You can grow even more this summer

text_block_list.text:
"Following this, the academy-sponsored 
summer training camp will take place. It 
is said that an Umamusume's abilities grow 
by leaps and bounds during the summer."
choice_data_list:
I'll give it my all too, so let's get 
stronger together!

I'll do my best too, so let's get stronger 
together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will follow you, 
Trainer...!

And so, the next goal was decided: the 
sprint GⅠ, the Sprinters Stakes.
